name: Memory Expunger
body:
Price 135,000 gp; Slot —; Weight 1 lb.; Capacity 20; Usage 5

DESCRIPTION

This small metal-and-glass disk has a red button along its perimeter. As a standard action, you can presenting the disk to a creature within 10 feet and press the button; a series of flashing lights directly affects the creature’s brain, erasing the last 5 minutes of their memory as per modify memory. The creature can attempt a DC 20 Will saving throw to negate this effect. A creature currently being threatened by you or your allies receives a +4 circumstance bonus to the save, and anyone aware of the attempt can also try to avoid it as it would a gaze attack. A creature that succeeds at the save is instead dazzled for 1d4+4 rounds. This is a mind-affecting effect.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Craft DC 23; Cost 65,000 gp; Feats Craft Technological Item, Equipment production lab
